title.en: Find the discovery frames in the capture

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and show only PPPoE discovery (PADI, PADO, PADR, PADS, PADT).
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur sirf PPPoE discovery (PADI, PADO, PADR, PADS, PADT) dikhao.

expect.en: Four frames at the start (PADI, PADO, PADR, PADS) and a PADT at the end; the session ID appears in PADS.
expect.hinglish: Shuru mein chaar frames (PADI, PADO, PADR, PADS) aur end mein ek PADT; session ID PADS mein dikhti hai.

why.en: Filter the PPP login exchange: Challenge, Response, then Success or Failure.
why.hinglish: PPP login exchange filter karo: Challenge, Response, phir Success ya Failure.

expect.en: A 16-byte challenge, a response with the 16-byte MD5 hash and the username, then Success (code 3), or Failure (code 4) in the wrong-password scenario.
expect.hinglish: 16-byte challenge, 16-byte MD5 hash aur username wala response, phir Success (code 3), ya wrong-password scenario mein Failure (code 4).

title.en: See the IP address handed out by IPCP
title.hinglish: IPCP se mila IP address dekho

why.en: IPCP, not DHCP, gives the public IP and DNS on a PPPoE line.
why.hinglish: PPPoE line par public IP aur DNS DHCP nahi, IPCP deta hai.

expect.en: Configure-Request with 0.0.0.0, a Configure-Nak suggesting 198.51.100.7 and the DNS servers, then a Configure-Ack.
expect.hinglish: 0.0.0.0 wala Configure-Request, 198.51.100.7 aur DNS servers suggest karta Configure-Nak, phir Configure-Ack.

title.en: Check your MTU and whether you are on PPPoE
title.hinglish: Apna MTU check karo aur dekho PPPoE par ho ya nahi

why.en: A router on PPPoE uses MTU 1492; your own PC usually shows 1500 on its LAN, and the router's WAN page lists the PPPoE login.
why.hinglish: PPPoE par router MTU 1492 use karta hai; tumhara PC apne LAN par aam taur par 1500 dikhata hai, aur router ka WAN page PPPoE login list karta hai.

expect.en: A table of interfaces with their MTU, usually 1500 for Ethernet and Wi-Fi. A 1492 value appears only on a machine that itself dials PPPoE. Output varies by machine.
expect.hinglish: Interfaces ki table unke MTU ke saath, Ethernet aur Wi-Fi ke liye aam taur par 1500. 1492 value sirf us machine par dikhti hai jo khud PPPoE dial karti hai. Output machine ke hisaab se alag hota hai.
